title: Section C SC-22: --legacy-peer-deps comes from @flashbots/ethers-provider-bundle 1.0.0 pinning ethers to exactly 6.7.1 while the repo uses 6.16.0; .npmrc turns peer checks off for every package, so other peer conflicts stay hidden and the library runs on an ethers version it never declared

evidence.note: {"ethers":"6.7.1"}; the lock has a single node_modules/ethers at 6.16.0, so the library resolves the root copy

sibling_sites_checked: All peerDependencies in the base lockfile were not individually re-resolved (no npm install in Phase 22); the flashbots pin is the conflict named by the research hint and confirmed in the lock. The runtime use of the library (flashbots.ts) is the TX slice (AUD-TX-009 crash in its block listener).
severity_rationale: S3: dependency hygiene that can hide a breaking peer mismatch on the money path (the Flashbots bundle client), but nothing fails today.
recommendation: Phase 25: the interim npm overrides for ethers; Phase 29 (DEPS-05, OD-2): replace the library with the in-repo relay client, then delete .npmrc legacy-peer-deps and the CI flags so npm ci runs without them.
